_comment: Sample seed for 2 emotions (Anger and Gratitude) out of the 50. Full file in assets/data/emotions_seed.json (~2 000 lines).
_source: 50-cores.xlsx (source of truth). Cross-referenced with HeartOS/01_core_tables/emotions.md and HeartOS/07_appendices/50_core_emotions.md. Distribution in the xlsx: 30 Negative (IDs 1–30) and 20 Positive (IDs 31–50); the narrative appendix's count of '40 Negative · 10 Positive' was a documentation error corrected in the 2026-06-12 reaudit.
_authentication_standard: Quran references verified against the Mushaf; Hadith references cite recognised collections. Recommended Duas are authentic (Sayyidu'l-Istighfar for repentance, HasbiyAllahu la ilaha illa huwa for anxiety, etc.). See HeartOS/GLOSSARY.md §'Hadith authentication' for the full standard.
_known_issues: The 50_core_emotions.md detail section in 07_appendices/ had duplicate emotions 21–30 and was missing detail sections for emotions 31–40. The duplicate was removed in the 2026-06-12 reaudit; the missing detail sections for 31–40 remain a v1.1 task (the xlsx has the complete data). See AUDIT_REPORT.md §3.2 and the ⚠️ DATA QUALITY NOTE in 50_core_emotions.md.
